pairs.subject: standards-layered-runtime
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/layers.registry.ts:24 The console's only 'registry' is a list of React UI screens ('layers') for the wallet window, not an embeddable guest-language runtime installing standards-defined APIs into a context; searching the context directory for realm/guest/embedder/polyfill/quickjs/boa_engine/deno_core found nothing, and a repo-wide search for the engine and polyfill terms hit only .ai/ registry metadata and binary screenshots, so the subject's precondition (an engine plus external-standard API packages with third-party embedders) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/layers/core.tsx:49 defineLayer registers a UI screen for a route; there is no guest context, no baseline standard API set and no outside embedder adding extensions
